body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Florence, Italy. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 8 km. It starts at Palazzo Pitti, Piazza de' Pitti, 1, 50125 Firenze FI, Italy. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Palazzo Pitti, Boboli & Bardini Gardens. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Welcome to your self-guided audio tour of Florence, Italy, a city steeped in history, art, and architecture. This tour is perfect for anyone interested in uncovering the rich cultural and historical significance of Florence.
>
> Your journey begins at Palazzo Pitti, a grand Renaissance palace that was once the residence of the Medici family. Note that the ticket to Palazzo Pitti, Boboli & Bardini Gardens is included, but an audio tour inside the palace is not provided. From here, you will navigate through various historic sites such as the Boboli Gardens, Palazzo Vecchio, Ponte Vecchio, and the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, among others. The tour will conclude at Piazzale Michelangelo, offering a panoramic view of the city.
>
> As you walk through Florence, you will delve into the history of the Medici family, the Renaissance era, and the architectural and artistic treasures that make Florence unique. You will see iconic landmarks like the Baptistery of St. John, the Uffizi Galleries, and the Basilica of Santa Croce. Each stop will reveal a piece of Florence's rich tapestry, from its medieval roots to its modern-day charm.
>
> On your way, you will have memorable experiences such as admiring Michelangelo's sculptures, walking across the historic Ponte Vecchio, and taking in the breathtaking views of the city from Piazzale Michelangelo. This tour will leave you with a deep appreciation for the city's history, art, and architecture.
